meta.summary: I created a comprehensive high-level diagram for a personal website, breaking it down into 6 interconnected components: Pages (Home, About, Projects, etc.), Navigation (header/footer structure), Content (bio, skills, project showcases), Styling & UX (colors, typography, responsiveness), Tech Stack (framework and tool options), and Deployment & SEO (hosting and discoverability). The diagram shows how these elements connect - for example, how the tech stack influences the pages you can build, and how navigation ties everything together for a cohesive user experience.

The core pages your site should have:
- **Home** — intro, hero section, tagline

- **Blog / Writing** *(optional)* — articles or thoughts

n_1776226763662_10.content:

- **Resume / CV** — downloadable PDF or dedicated page

n_1776226765584_11.content:

Making it look and feel good:
- **Color Palette** — 2–3 primary colors, light/dark mode
- **Typography** — readable fonts, clear hierarchy (H1/H2/body)
- **Responsive Layout** — works on mobile, tablet, desktop
- **Animations** — subtle transitions, hover effects
- **Accessibility** — contrast ratios, alt text, keyboard nav", "parent_id": "n_1776226758248_6"}
